        "All four owned paths/771diff lines read: new native radio/expansion/status/provider controls, JS preference bindings and async init, all English Fluent labels/arguments, selected/expanded/forced-color CSS. Native group values0/2/3/5 mean Default/Increased/Max/Off in this UI, not four Boolean states. Labels are associated by aria-labelledby and explicit Fluent IDs; no live accessible-tree/focus/contrast proof.",
        "The actual owned and accepted init awaits DoHConfigController.init before initDoH, adopting the reviewer initialization-order request. Provider selection reads resolved currentConfig providerList/fallbackProviderURI rather than the removed JSON resolver preference. A missing default adds a URI-only stub to the returned providers array; controller snapshot/ownership semantics are unpaired. Data shipment3804is distinct and cannot alone prove readiness.",
        "Selecting a custom provider shows its field and writes its value to network.trr.uri; an empty field writes a single space rather than empty string. Other selection writes its URI. The second mode menu is synchronized explicitly. An empty current URI uses default_provider_uri for selection; no actual network fallback or URL-validation result is inferred from these strings.",
        "Mode handling clears URI and disable-heuristics for Default0, fills configured fallbackProviderURI only for an empty URI in2/3, and clears URI for Off5. Unknown values select the Off row without a direct pref write in that branch. The mode lock disables the radiogroup and copies the current custom value; this is not proof every provider/edit control is disabled or that full policy enforcement is covered.",
        "updateDoHStatus reads current DNS mode/confirmation/URI fields and computes a display label. Its async nested setStatus formats localized text but is invoked without await or return. Awaiting the outer method alone therefore does not establish final status-label translation. No out-of-order result or observed UI failure is claimed. Invalid URI label and resolver visibility are separate paths.",
        "Initialization registers URI/mode preference handlers, three DNS observers and once-only unload cleanup. Arrow commands toggle expanded/up classes and aria-expanded. These source contracts do not prove all preference listener teardown or nested click-target behavior. The outer pane-loader await contract and Gecko controller/service definitions remain bounded.",
